item.title: Efficiently Loading Multiple Variables from R Data Files Using `get` and `mget`
item.description:
“Efficiently Loading Multiple Variables from R Data Files Using get and mget”

What are the recommended, cleaner alternatives for batch loading variables from multiple R data files, particularly when avoiding the cumulative complexity associated with repeated calls to get()?

Dynamic Variable Retrieval in R for Batch Processing

The direct application of data <- get(i) inside a loop or function where i is a string naming the desired variable presents syntactic challenges for maintainability in large-scale operations.

item.title: Swift Data Conversion Techniques: Value Types to Data and Back
item.description:
“Swift Data Conversion Techniques: Value Types to Data and Back”

When working with network operations, file storage, or low-level data manipulation in Swift, converting fundamental value types (like Double, Int, or arrays of these) to and from the Data type is a frequent requirement. This exploration details robust Swift techniques, emphasizing safety, alignment constraints, and protocol-oriented alternatives for these conversions, particularly noting changes in recent Swift versions (up to Swift 5).

item.title: Solved-How-to-Parse-JSON-in-Java-with-Leading-Libraries
item.description:
“Solved-How-to-Parse-JSON-in-Java-with-Leading-Libraries”

Parsing JSON data is a fundamental task for many Java applications, especially when dealing with web services and APIs. JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) has become the de-facto standard for data interchange due to its lightweight nature and human-readable format. This guide delves into various effective methods and popular libraries available in Java to parse JSON strings, extract values, and map them to Java objects.
